scope: 325 published English town packages and their bundled standalone Home attractions.

policy.boundaries: Official locality geometry is preserved; active visitor geometry may close internal green-space gaps but cannot add more than 30% automatically.
policy.towns: Tourist appeal uses the editorial 0-3 destination-draw scale.
policy.see: Up to 20 in-boundary attractions, ranked by 0-100 score.
policy.eat: Up to 20 daytime food stops, ranked by the food-specific 0-100 scale.
policy.trails: All linked trails carry a 0-100 trail score and are ordered highest first.
policy.practical: All curated practical places must be public, in-boundary, location-specific and honest about unknown tariffs.
policy.heritage: Only defensible dates extracted from locally captured official Historic England text are published.
